title: Cultural Value Alignment in Large Language Models: A Prompt-based Analysis of Schwartz Values in Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 40-item Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ) to language models via prompting to evaluate their alignment with Schwartz's basic human values, and using a Bayesian ordinal regression model to compare value prioritization between Western-trained models (ChatGPT, Gemini) and an Eastern-trained model (DeepSeek).
